messages:
Maya Chen (CS): Quick heads-up — 12 trial and POC tenants in EMEA hit 401s during VPC/private onboarding earlier today. Want to align on a single status note + mitigation offer before we outbound. Draft below.

Sam Ortiz (Support): saw the spikes in the auth-service logs, put a tag on affected tenant IDs. I can attach the list.

Jon Patel (Platform): short RCA from infra: control plane deployment v2.14.1 introduced a propagation race for KMS-backed token injection. Newly provisioned instances sometimes started without the token, so calls to our auth gateway returned 401.

Luis Gomez (Solutions): mitigation we used for the first 3 tenants: re-trigger token provisioning and warm the instance metadata. Quick script to reissue token and restart onboarding agent:
```
#!/bin/bash
for id in $(cat affected-tenants.txt); do
  redwoodctl tokens reissue --tenant $id --force
  redwoodctl onboard restart --tenant $id
 done
```
Ran OK for tenant-101, tenant-102.

Alyssa Reed (AE): important for renewal conversations — what's our customer-facing ask? Can we offer a 1:1 onboarding session + small credit? Some of these are in late-stage trials.

Maya Chen (CS): Draft status for customers (short):
- What happened: during provisioning some customers received a 401 due to a token injection delay.
- Impact: onboarding stalled for a subset of tenants; no data loss, only provisioning and initial API calls affected.
- What we did: identified root cause, rolled a patch to control plane, reissued tokens for affected tenants, and provided a remediation script.
- Next steps: offer a live troubleshooting session, share a short how-to to re-trigger provisioning, apply a one-time 10% trial credit or 2-week extended trial on request.

Nina Park (CS Manager): sounds good. Make the language non-technical for customers and include an optional invite link for office hours. Also add a polite apology line.

Jon Patel (Platform): add technical note for engineering customers: the fix is a config propagation guard in v2.14.2; rolling deploy in progress across regions. We also added a health check so control plane won't flip to "ready" until tokens are present.

Maya Chen (CS): updated draft below (customer-facing):
Hi — we’re reaching out about an issue some customers experienced today during Private/VPC onboarding where initial API calls returned authentication errors. We’re sorry for the disruption.
What we’ve done: fixed the underlying control-plane deployment, reissued credentials for affected accounts, and confirmed onboarding completion for tenants we’ve remediated.
How we’ll help: we’re offering a complimentary 30-minute onboarding troubleshooting session, and a one-time 10% credit or 14-day trial extension. Reply if you want the session and we'll schedule.
If you prefer technical detail, reply and we’ll include the mitigation steps and logs.

Luis Gomez (Solutions): +1 to the session + credit. Can we include the quick remediation command for self-serve customers? Put it as an optional technical appendix in the note and link to internal runbook: <https://redwood.internal/docs/vpc-onboard-recovery>.

Alyssa Reed (AE): can we get a CSV of affected accounts and status flags (remediated / pending / asked-for-session)? I’ll prioritize outreach for high-renewal-risk customers.

Sam Ortiz (Support): attaching list to the thread (uploaded file). I’ll mark tenant state as I run the remediation script.

Maya Chen (CS): schedule: send customer note in 60 minutes, open slots for office hours later today 15:00-17:00 CET, and tomorrow 09:00-11:00 CET. OpsBot: please queue the status email and the internal incident note.

OpsBot: Scheduled outbound: customer-status-email-1735001234 -> sending in 60m. Internal incident doc created: /incidents/1735001234-vpc-token-propagation.

Nina Park (CS Manager): thanks team. After sending, please paste the outbound copy and a short list of which tenants asked for the session so AE/success can follow up. :thumbsup:

Maya Chen (CS): will do — I'll post the final outbound here after OpsBot sends.

Jon Patel (Platform): follow-up: we expect the full rollout of v2.14.2 in EMEA to complete within 2 hours. I'll ping when the deploy finishes.

Maya Chen (CS): great, keep me posted.
